## Passages
RESULT [continual]: Across 10 distribution-shift datasets, fine-tuning is about 2% better in-distribution but about 7% worse out-of-distribution than linear probing. LP-FT beats full fine-tuning by 1% in-distribution and 10% out-of-distribution.
US [continual]: When an increment adds a new species, the new head outputs start random. Warming up the head only, then unfreezing, is a cheap schedule tweak that protects the base features. The evidence is from classification, not detection.
CORRECTION [continual]: ICLR 2022 oral. Across 10 datasets, FT is about 2% better ID and 7% worse OOD than LP. LP-FT beats FT by 1% ID and 10% OOD.
